faqs.question: How does the ordering process work without an online checkout?
faqs.answer: BestGrassFedCattle operates on an authentic direct relationship model. When you click "ORDER THIS ITEM", you submit an order request with your desired quantity, cut thickness, and contact preference. Our farm team reviews our freshly prepared stock, reaches out to you directly via your chosen method (phone, email, WhatsApp, or Telegram) to confirm availability and logistics, and finalizes the order personally.

faqs.question: What does 100% Grass-Fed and Grass-Finished mean?
faqs.answer: Our cattle spend their entire lives grazing open Kansas pastures on a natural rotational diet of clover, orchard grass, and timothy. Unlike industrial beef, our cattle never step foot in a feedlot and are never fed grains, corn silage, antibiotics, or synthetic growth hormones.

faqs.question: How do Bulk & Wholesale orders work for restaurants and butchers?
faqs.answer: Commercial establishments, caterers, and private clubs can visit our Bulk & Wholesale page to submit volume requirements (quarter steers, half steers, whole carcasses, or bulk ground beef). Our wholesale director will respond within 24 hours with wholesale volume schedules and cut sheet sheets.

faqs.question: Can I request custom cut thicknesses or bone-in options?
faqs.answer: Yes! When submitting an order request for steaks or roasts, select your preferred thickness or specify custom requirements in the "Special Instructions" box. Our butcher cuts to order.

testimonials.quote: We ordered a quarter beef share for our deep freezer. Every single cut—from the ground beef to the tenderloin roasts—has been exceptional. The direct communication made everything seamless.
The marbling and mineral clean finish on BestGrassFedCattle’s ribeye cuts set a new standard for our steak program. Our guests notice the difference immediately.
